files.description: Shipments (400 rows): shipment_id (whole number), ordered_on and shipped_on (dates as text, YYYY-MM-DD, in 2025; shipped_on is empty for about 4% of rows that have not shipped yet), carrier (DHL, UPS, PostNord or GLS; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), weight_kg (one decimal), value (order value, two decimals).

task_text: Between the first and the last order date (both included), which calendar days had no orders at all? Give each such day as a day number counted from 1970-01-01 (that date is day 0). `result` should be a sorted Python list of these day numbers.
intended_computation: List every day from 2025-01-02 to 2025-12-19 on which no shipment was ordered (117 days) as the number of days since 1970-01-01 (2025-01-02 is day 20090), sorted ascending.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the generated day range uses a coarser unit, so integer division by a nanosecond day gives wrong day numbers

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
